rationale: Explicit user authorization covers a fresh, bounded, read-only R2 concurrency acceptance proof after R1 failed only because the child scope overlapped parent A. Parent A may inspect only .agents/rules/11-orchestrator-subagent-delegation.md; parent B may inspect only docs/templates/MULTIAGENT_PROMPT_COMMAND.md and may run generated/catalog sync checks only after that inspection; the one nested child may inspect only .agents/skills/orchestrator-delegation/SKILL.md. Root plus two same-role explorer parents and exactly one child uses all four slots. Require distinct fresh nonces, monotonic intervals, parent-child forwarding, equal worktree fingerprints, changed_files=[], and no overlapping evidence. No external CLI/network action, writable ownership, work prompt, or repository mutation is authorized.
